verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents creating a flag from the dashboard (Features > Create Feature) and toggling it per environment without deploying new code, which covers creating a flag and toggling it live in production. The 'within minutes of signing up' part is not evidenced: there is no signup or quickstart flow and no hands-on time-to-first-flag report. missing for 10: evidence of a fast signup-to-first-flag onboarding path (quickstart/hosted signup), independent hands-on corroboration of time-to-value.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create a feature flag and toggle it live in production within minutes of signing up

citations.quote: Go to the **Features** section in your dashboard. Click **Create Feature**.
Easily toggle individual features on and off, and make changes without deploying new code
use Flagsmith to toggle that feature on or off for different environments, users or user segments.
